m.s: Heat the oven to 160°C. Stab {lamb_sh} all over with a small knife. Rub with crushed {garlic}, {oregano}, the finely grated zest of {lemon}, a good glug of oil and plenty of salt, pushing it into the cuts.
Put the lamb in a roasting tin with 1 cup water and cover tightly with foil. Roast for 3 hours until it pulls apart easily with a fork.
While the lamb roasts, boil {potato} whole in salted water for 15 minutes until a knife slides in. Drain and let them cool and steam dry.

Take the lamb out, keep it covered to rest and turn the oven up to 220°C. Smash the potatoes flat on an oiled tray with the bottom of a glass. Drizzle with oil, season and roast for 30 minutes until crispy.
Mix {yoghurt} with chopped {mint}, a squeeze of the lemon and a pinch of salt. Chop {cos} and {cucumber} and dress with the rest of the lemon juice, oil and salt.
Shred the lamb off the bone with two forks and spoon over some of the pan juices. Serve with the potatoes, salad and mint yoghurt.

l: Lamb, potatoes and salad in one container, yoghurt on the side. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
